basics.name: Zohaib Malik
basics.label: AI & NLP Research Assistant & Software Engineering Student
basics.summary: Final-year Software Engineering student at GIKI with hands-on research experience in low-resource NLP and LLM fine-tuning, including a supervised research project and a co-authored IEEE conference paper. Ranked 13th nationally at ICPC Asia Regional 2025. Proficient with PyTorch, QLoRA/LoRA fine-tuning, and empirical evaluation pipelines.

work.position: AI Research Assistant (Supervised by Dr. Khurram Jadoon)
work.summary: Fine-tuned Qehwa LLM (Qwen2.5-7B) on ~74,966 Afghan Pashto instruction pairs using QLoRA, LoRA, Unsloth, and PyTorch. Co-authored an IEEE conference paper on Pashto LLM fine-tuning methodology.
Architected and deployed full-stack P2P textbook exchange platform serving 500+ GIKI students, processing 200+ weekly transactions with FastAPI, React + Vite, Docker, and PostgreSQL.

publications.name: Pashto LLM: Fine-Tuning Methodology and Experimental Results for Low-Resource Dialect Adaptation
publications.summary: Describing the dataset curation, dialect-mixing mitigation, and QLoRA fine-tuning pipeline for Afghan Pashto LLM domain adaptation.
